vah_pada_scope: Kāśikā 1.3.81 illustrates direct pra + vah with P and ā + vah with A. Mādhavīya 654 separately attributes a P-only view under direct pari to some commentators. Kṣīrasvāmin has both padas for the ordered pra + ni example.
interposed_augment: Mādhavīya quotes प्रण्यवहदित्यत्रापि; the source has voiced -d before iti, compared with written final -t in the pausal root table.
